title: Trailside Equestrian Centre
specs: Lessons offered indoors November through April and outdoors May through October, weather permitting
Trail rides through scenic woods of Lockwood Park and Anna Page Park
Weight limit 190 lbs for riding in group lessons (beginner level)
Weight limit 200 lbs for trail ride class
Weight limit 230 lbs for trail rides
Must be under 100 pounds to participate in Pony Experience riding activities
Pony Experience minimum age 2 years old; 2 and 3 year olds must be accompanied by parent/guardian
Riders must be up to 48 inches tall and 80 lbs and under for pony rides at Fall on the Farm
Group packages for field trips require minimum 10 participants and pre-scheduling
Shelters can be rented for group events for an additional fee
includes: Grooming and tacking/untacking included in lessons
Pony Experience includes riding a pony/small horse
gap: Exact cancellation policy for lessons not stated
blurb: Guests can take private, semi-private, or group horseback riding lessons at various skill levels, enjoy a pony experience with grooming and riding, and participate in guided trail rides through the woods. The facility also offers seasonal fall farm events with pony rides and other activities. Rentals of shelters and a cookhouse are available for picnics and parties.
extraNote: Pony Experience tickets must be shown at Covered Arena at ticketed time · Pony Experience cancellation or reschedule requires 24 hours notice for full refund · Pony Experience cancelled by operator will be rescheduled or refunded · Arrive 15 minutes prior to trail ride leave time · Covered Arena (east side of Trailside Center) for Pony Experience; Trailside Stable for lessons; ticket booth parking lot for Fall on the Farm
